title: Transports and runtime sessions
routing: Is this about how a session reaches its model? Picking or building a transport (createSession(kind, config), TRANSPORTS[kind].capabilities, describeTransport), the concrete sessions ClaudeCodeSession (claude CLI stream-json, control protocol, steer push, CLAUDE_TEXT_ONLY_ARGS), ClaudeAgentSdkSession (caller-supplied query, sdkOptionsFromArgv), CodexAppServerSession (codex app-server --listen stdio://, codexPermissions), JsonRpcConnection, MuseSession (muse serve, permissionMode mapped by musePermissions, onUserInput, XDG homes, 1.4.25 pin), the AcpSession/ApiSession stubs and TransportUnavailableError, readLimits and rate_limit events on an open session, or the no-API-billing rule.
